description_en: Calls DeleteRouteEntries to batch delete custom route entries
description_zh: 调用DeleteRouteEntries批量删除自定义路由条目
kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-route-entries --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --route-entries DstCidrBlock=47.100.XX.XX/24 RouteEntryId=rte-bp1mnnr2al0naomnpv0000 RouteTableId=vtb-2ze3jgygk9bmsj23s0000 NextHop=i-j6c2fp57q8rr4jlu0000 --dry-run true --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteRouteEntries

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the route table resides.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
路由表所属地域的ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en:
The destination CIDR block of the route entry to delete. IPv4 CIDR blocks, IPv6 CIDR blocks, and prefix list CIDR blocks are supported. You can specify up to 50 destination CIDR blocks.

If the RouteEntryId parameter is not specified, the DstCidrBlock and NextHop parameters are required
fields.help_zh:
要删除的路由条目的目标网段，支持IPv4网段、IPv6网段和前缀列表网段。最多支持输入50个目标网段。

当RouteEntryId参数未输入时，DstCidrBlock和NextHop参数必填
fields.name: dst_cidr_block

fields.help_en:
The ID of the next hop instance to delete. You can specify up to 50 instance IDs.

If the RouteEntryId parameter is not specified, the DstCidrBlock and NextHop parameters are required
fields.help_zh:
要删除的下一跳实例的ID。最多支持输入50个实例ID。

当RouteEntryId参数未输入时，DstCidrBlock和NextHop参数必填
fields.name: next_hop

fields.help_en:
The ID of the route entry to delete. You can specify up to 50 route entry IDs.

If the RouteEntryId parameter is not specified, the DstCidrBlock and NextHop parameters are required
fields.help_zh:
要删除的路由条目ID。最多支持输入50个路由条目ID。

当RouteEntryId参数未输入时，DstCidrBlock和NextHop参数必填
fields.name: route_entry_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the route table that contains the route entry to delete. You can specify up to 50 route table IDs
fields.help_zh: 要删除的路由条目所在的路由表的ID。最多支持输入50个路由表ID
fields.name: route_table_id

parameters.help_en: The information about the route entries to delete
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的路由条目信息
parameters.name: route_entries

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without deleting routes. The system checks the AccessKey pair, the authorization of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user, and the required parameters. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.

false (default): sends a normal request. If the check passes, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the routes are deleted
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送请求，不会删除路由条目。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，会返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回2xx HTTP状态码并直接删除路由条目
parameters.name: dry_run

FailedCount.description_en: The number of route entries that failed to be deleted
FailedCount.description_zh: 删除失败的路由条目数

FailedRouteEntries.description_en: The information about the route entries that failed to be deleted
FailedRouteEntries.description_zh: 删除失败的路由条目信息

items.description_en: The information about the route entries that failed to be deleted
items.description_zh: 删除失败的路由条目信息

DstCidrBlock.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the route entry that failed to be deleted. IPv4 CIDR blocks, IPv6 CIDR blocks, and prefix list CIDR blocks are supported
DstCidrBlock.description_zh: 删除失败的路由条目的目标网段，支持IPv4网段、IPv6网段和前缀列表网段

FailedCode.description_en: The error code of the failure

FailedMessage.description_en: The error message of the failure

NextHop.description_en: The instance ID of the next hop that failed to be deleted
NextHop.description_zh: 删除失败的下一跳实例ID

RouteEntryId.description_en: The ID of the route entry that failed to be deleted

SuccessCount.description_en: The number of route entries that were successfully deleted
SuccessCount.description_zh: 删除成功的路由条目数
